WITH track_rates AS (
  SELECT 
    t.TrackId,
    t.MediaTypeId,
    t.Bytes * 1.0 / t.Milliseconds AS byte_rate
  FROM Track t
  WHERE t.Bytes IS NOT NULL
),
media_type_rates AS (
  SELECT 
    m.MediaTypeId,
    m.Name,
    AVG(tr.byte_rate) AS rate
  FROM track_rates tr
  JOIN MediaType m ON tr.MediaTypeId = m.MediaTypeId
  GROUP BY m.MediaTypeId, m.Name
),
overall_average AS (
  SELECT AVG(rate) AS avg_rate
  FROM media_type_rates
)
SELECT 
  mtr.Name,
  mtr.rate,
  mtr.rate - oa.avg_rate AS above_average
FROM media_type_rates mtr
CROSS JOIN overall_average oa
WHERE mtr.rate > oa.avg_rate
ORDER BY mtr.Name
